Masterclass Performances

From foundational piano fingering to Trinity Grade 8 diplomas and live stage performance rehearsals — discover your pathway to musicianship.

Certified Musical Disciplines

Each course follows a certified syllabus with continuous assessment, stage exposure, and grade exam preparation.

Initial to Grade 8 2 Sessions / Week

Electronic Keyboard & Piano

Structured western classical notation, both-hand coordination, major/minor scales, arpeggios, sight-reading, chord accompaniment, and film song transcription.

  • Treble & Bass Clef sight reading
  • Harmony, Chord Inversions & Voicing
  • Trinity College London Exam Preparation
Inquire Fees
Acoustic & Classical Weekend & Weekdays

Acoustic & Classical Guitar

Master posture, plectrum control, open & barre chords, fingerstyle picking, scale runs, lead melodies, and accompaniment across genres.

  • Tablature & standard music notation
  • Rhythm strumming & syncopation
  • Soloing, scales & fingerstyle arrangements
Inquire Fees
Voice Culture Sugama Sangeetha

Vocal Coaching & Singing

Comprehensive voice training rooted in classical swaras, pitch calibration, breath diaphragmatic control, and expressive light music phrasing.

  • Shruti alignment & pitch stabilization
  • Breath power, range expansion & falsetto
  • Microphone technique & live performance
